bilateral_axis.basis: named right/left stump, thigh and foot pivots

longitudinal_sign.basis: central named chain EUBUM -> EUTAIL -> EUBODY -> EUNECK02 -> EUNECK01 -> EUHEAD -> EUJAW

conclusion.exported_model_front_axis: root(EUBUM) maps +X to approximately +Z with +4 degree X component
conclusion.calibration_policy: Use source XAF root transform and +X anatomical front. Do not add arbitrary 90/180 degree yaw correction.

caveats: EUEYE transform is a pathological outlier and must not be used for aggregate PCA/front inference.
NPC direction vectors are world-facing state evidence, not geometry waypoints.
